product_metadata.title: Walensee Throw Blanket for Couch, 50 x 60 Dark Cyan, Acrylic Knit Woven Summer Blanket, Lightweight Decorative Soft Nap Throw with Tassel for Chair Bed Sofa Travel Picnic, Suitable for All Seasons
features: CONSTRUCTION & SIZE: 100% high quality acrylic braided throw blanket, measures 50" x 60", weighted 1.10 lbs. Walensee cozy thin accent throw has super soft silky touch, strong anti-sunlight and excellent light fastness. With decorative fringes will not easily unravel.

VERSATILE: Drape Walensee weave throw over a bed, couch, ladder, loveseat or chair can bring a stylish touch to your living room or bedroom. Perfect for indoor and outdoor use to keep you warm enough on those chilly days, especially for camping, picnic, movie theater, park, farmhouse, hotel, tent, airplane or Christmas gift. And it’s also a good choice to use it as a scarf in winter!

SUPER SOFT & LIGHTWEIGHT: Classic and comfortable, the cover plaid throw breathable and moisture absorption enough to keep you from breaking out in a sweat. And it's a perfect thermal blanket in home.
CLASSY DESIGN & GIFT IDEA: Special knitted checkered pattern and fringes for added style and a great gift choice. Perfect for homeowners with sophisticated taste in home décor.
EASY CARE: Machine washes in cold water on a gentle cycle, tumble dry low or lay flat to dry. Tips: Do not hang to dry.
